bindings.caption: CIPS crystals were ground into powder with micrometer sizes. Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

CIPS powder was mixed with n-hexane solution of n-butyllithium. Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The reactor was heated to 393 K and held for 120 min. temperature: 393 K. duration: 120 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The reactor was cooled down to room temperature. Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The powder was washed with n-hexane to remove surplus n-butyllithium. Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The powder was dispersed in distilled water by ultrasonication in ice . Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

The suspension was centrifuged at 1000 rpm for 15 min. duration: 15 min. Recipe-level reported vessel: poly(tetrafluoroethylene) reactor. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
